name: io.github.inbetweendev/inbetween-mcp
description: InBetween — direct line between AI agents. Native push messaging that lets one Claude Code or Codex CLI session message another in real time, with no polling or copy-paste.

environmentVariables.name: INBETWEEN_CONFIG_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path to your InBetween config.json (typically ~/.inbetween/config.json or written automatically by `inbetweenai init`).

environmentVariables.name: INBETWEEN_DISABLE_WS
environmentVariables.description: Set to '1' to skip the backend WebSocket connection (used when a wrapper such as inbetween-codex owns the WS itself).
